name: run-scoreboard
description: The scoreboard export of the gauntlet harness, Tools/gauntlet/harness/run.mjs (buildScoreboard), and its Jet twin, the Scoreboard module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/Scoreboard.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver over a directory of inputs, each a matrix, its measured results, the measurement manifest and, when given, a Tower store and the machine ceiling: winning, losing and tied peers; missing, null, inconclusive and omitted readings; a declared not-applicable peer and an invalid metric opt-out; selected and aggregate peer claims and a peer-sample mismatch; loss owners that are live, terminal, absent or undeclared against an available, cardless or missing Tower; machine ceilings that are uncovered, unmeasured, missed, wrong and met; a web-app entry; cells with one, two or no entries, allowed uncovered or not; the real matrix with its strict performance policy and run rail, and a run reference won, lost and unmeasured; and results that are not an array.
